instructions.name: apply_emergency_close
docs: Apply emergency close after 24hr timelock. Permissionless.
Closes the Position + Vault PDAs without Meteora CPI.
Any remaining vault tokens are transferred to the position owner.

instructions.name: claim_fees
docs: Claim accrued Meteora LP fees -> user (no protocol fee on LP fees)

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller: authorized bot or vault owner

accounts.name: user_vault
docs: UserVault PDA — gas deducted from here

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Bot closes position: remove all + claim fees + close Meteora position.

accounts.name: user_vault
docs: UserVault PDA — receives rent on close + gas deduction source

instructions.name: create_vault
docs: Create a vault PDA for a user. Anyone can pay rent. The vault is
cryptographically bound to `owner` via PDA seeds — no signer check needed.

accounts.name: owner
docs: means the vault is cryptographically bound to this pubkey regardless.

instructions.name: harvest_bins
docs: Bot harvests fully-converted bins. Anti-backwash mechanic.

accounts.name: user_vault
docs: UserVault PDA — receives harvested tokens, gas deducted from here

instructions.name: open_position_v2
docs: Open a DLMM position on behalf of a user vault.
Bot is the tx signer + rent payer. Tokens come from the user vault's ATA.
For SOL-side buys: inline wrapping via lamport manipulation + sync_native.

instructions.name: propose_emergency_close
docs: Propose emergency close of ANY position (user or rover). 24hr timelock.
For when Meteora deprecates a pool and normal close_position CPI fails.
NOTE: This can target user positions too — intentional for stuck positions
on deprecated pools. The 24hr timelock gives users time to see and react.

instructions.name: set_fee_bps
docs: Direct admin-gated fee setter. Replaces the prior propose/apply timelock.
Defensively clears any in-flight pending_fee state from the prior pattern.

instructions.name: set_fee_dest
docs: Admin sets the destination wallet for harvest_bins protocol fees.
Pass `Pubkey::default()` to fall back to `Config.bot` (legacy behavior).
Will be retargeted to the Hopper program PDA once Hopper ships.

instructions.name: unwrap_wsol_in_vault
docs: Unwrap WSOL in vault back to native SOL.
Closes the vault's WSOL ATA — token balance returns to vault PDA,
ATA rent returns to caller (bot paid for creation, bot gets rent back).
Called after harvest/close that produces WSOL, or before withdraw_sol.

instructions.name: update_gas_lamports
docs: Admin sets gas reimbursement amount per operation.

instructions.name: user_close
docs: User or bot closes position. Caller must be authorized bot or vault owner.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller: authorized bot or vault owner (real wallet)

accounts.name: user_vault
docs: UserVault PDA — authorization checked in handler body (dual-caller)

instructions.name: withdraw_sol
docs: Withdraw native SOL from user vault to the vault owner's wallet.
Caller must be authorized bot or the vault owner.

instructions.name: withdraw_token
docs: Withdraw SPL/Token-2022 tokens from user vault ATA to owner's ATA.
Caller must be authorized bot or the vault owner.

instructions.name: wrap_sol_in_vault
docs: Wrap native SOL in user vault to WSOL in the vault's WSOL ATA.
Uses direct lamport manipulation (bin-farm owns the vault PDA) + sync_native CPI.
Bot calls this before open_position_v2 for SOL-side buys.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidBinRange
errors.msg: Invalid bin range (min must be <= max)

errors.name: NonContiguousBins
errors.msg: Bin IDs must be contiguous (no gaps)

errors.name: FeeTimelockNotExpired
errors.msg: Fee timelock not expired (24 hours required)

errors.name: NothingToSweep
errors.msg: Nothing to sweep (rover authority has no excess SOL)

errors.name: RoverBinStepTooSmall
errors.msg: Rover bin_step too small (minimum 20 — prevents instant liquidation on tight pools)

errors.name: InvalidDistPool
errors.msg: dist_pool cannot be the null address

errors.name: BotNotStale
errors.msg: Bot is still active — permissionless harvest not yet available

errors.name: MissingKeeperAta
errors.msg: Permissionless harvester must provide keeper ATA in remaining_accounts

errors.name: PrioritySlotsExceedMax
errors.msg: Priority slots exceed maximum (9000 slots / ~1 hour)

errors.name: EmergencyCloseTimelockNotExpired
errors.msg: Emergency close timelock not expired (24 hours required)

errors.name: InvalidMintData
errors.msg: Invalid mint account data (too short to read decimals)

errors.name: TraderDestNotSet
errors.msg: Trader destination not set — call set_trader_dest first

errors.name: TraderDestAlreadySet
errors.msg: Trader destination already set — use propose_trader_dest for changes

errors.name: InvalidVaultOwner
errors.msg: Invalid vault owner — does not match PDA seed

errors.name: UnauthorizedCaller
errors.msg: Caller must be authorized bot or vault owner

errors.name: BurnCurveAlreadyInitialized
errors.msg: Burn curve already initialized — initial_crank_supply is immutable

errors.name: BurnCurveNotInitialized
errors.msg: Burn curve not initialized — call initialize_burn_curve first

errors.name: InvalidCrankMint
errors.msg: CRANK mint account does not match expected mint

errors.name: InvalidFeeDest
errors.msg: Fee destination account does not match Config.fee_dest (or Config.bot if unset)

types.name: PositionCounter
docs: Per-user-per-pool counter for deterministic meteora position PDA derivation.
Enables multiple positions per pool without requiring a keypair signer.

types.name: UserVault
docs: Per-user vault PDA. Holds SOL + token ATAs. Replaces custodial keypairs.
Seeds: [b"user_vault", owner.as_ref()]
owner = user's real Solana wallet (immutable withdrawal destination).
